query_text: Create a bubble chart comparing the top 15 companies founded in 2015 or later, where the x-axis is `Headcount per $100M raised`, the y-axis is `IPO probability`, bubble size is `Mosaic`, and points are colored by whether `Commercial Maturity` is below 5 or equal to 5.
value_unit: Headcount per $100M raised vs IPO probability
sort_rule: descending by IPO probability within the founded-2015-or-later subset
selection_rule: top 15 companies founded in 2015 or later with numeric funding, headcount, Mosaic, and Commercial Maturity

plot_config.title: IPO probability vs headcount intensity for recent companies

reasoning_summary: Filtered to companies founded in 2015 or later with numeric funding, headcount, Mosaic, and Commercial Maturity.
Converted funding to units of $100M and computed headcount intensity.
Bucketed Commercial Maturity into below 5 versus exactly 5.
Ranked by IPO probability and kept the top 15 companies.
